answer: One onyx seal in the public atlas buys one identity. Its fee rides the tide: the first hundred seals each epoch cost 30 credits, each further hundred doubles it, so seals 901-1,000 cost 15,360 each. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,069,000 credits for 40,000 rewards at most. A slow drip fails: the fee falls one step per quiet epoch. The atlas is public, so the fee is replayable; an honest agent pays 30 once for its onyx seal and keeps its reward.
